tailoring.headline: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant | Java & Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional enterprise e-commerce developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large-scale platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, data modeling, solution design and stakeholder management. Adept at requirements analysis, technical governance, system integrations, code reviews and leading international teams through complex delivery cycles. SAP Certified Professional Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Architecte B2C Commerce Cloud / Salesforce (H/F)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Magellan as a techno-functional expert to drive complex platform architectures and transformations. With over five years of specialized experience designing, implementing, and governing enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a proven track record of bridging business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

bullets.label: Solution Design & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, establishing robust design patterns, data flows, and system architectures across international environments.

bullets.label: Technical Governance & Delivery
bullets.text: Led technical code reviews, supervised integration pipelines between PIM, ERP, and e-commerce layers, and ensured high-quality deliverables from design to production deployment.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & Client Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as a key techno-functional link between business and IT, translating complex business requirements into scalable platform solutions and managing international stakeholder relationships.

bullets.label: API & Headless Ecosystems
bullets.text: Architected and exposed headless OCC REST web services and integrated progressive web applications, driving advanced digital capabilities and seamless multichannel user experiences.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on December 15, 2026, and am available to start on December 16, 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise platform expertise can support Magellan's clients.

tailoring.why_company: Magellan's commitment to combining deep business expertise with cutting-edge technological execution in a collaborative international environment strongly resonates with my professional background. I am eager to bring my extensive experience in enterprise e-commerce architecture, techno-functional consulting, and cross-functional team governance to help Magellan's clients successfully navigate their complex digital transformations.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, API integration, and techno-functional leadership to drive impactful digital transformations at Magellan.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a senior techno-functional e-commerce developer with 5+ years of enterprise platform delivery experience. I'm very interested in Magellan's architecture roles and would love to connect about your upcoming digital transformation projects.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Architecte B2C Commerce Cloud (Kranti Chavan)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Architecte B2C Commerce Cloud position at Magellan.

With over 5 years of experience architecting, integrating, and governing large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in system design, API integration, and techno-functional consulting.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and am available starting December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
